title: Users
description: GET /v2/users → userList (owner; capability users); GET|PATCH /v2/users/me → selfProfile, PATCH body selfProfilePatch, GET /v2/users/{id}/avatar → the image bytes with an ETag (capability users-self-profile); /v2/capabilities user → capabilityUser; cutex/userInput/routeAccepted params.actingUser → actingUser. Person identity (capability person-identity): GET /v2/identity/challenge → identityChallenge, POST /v2/identity/claim body identityClaim → identityClaimResult, PUT /v2/users/{id}/person-keys body personKeysPut → personKeysResult (owner); DELETE /v2/users/token-persons/{tokenId}/previous → tokenPersonPreviousCleared (owner; capability person-identity-ack). Own devices (capability user-own-devices; owner, root or a bound user, pending: 403 user_pending): GET /v2/users/me/devices → ownDevices, DELETE /v2/users/me/devices/{tokenId} → ownDeviceRevoked (404 client_token_not_found for a token not bound to the caller). Capability user-own-token: capabilityUser.token → ownToken or null (root credential). New owner devices (capability owner-device-notice; owner principals): GET /v2/users/owner/new-devices → ownerNewDevices, POST /v2/users/owner/new-devices/{tokenId}/ack → ownerDeviceAck. Capability device-scope: capabilityUser.scope, ownToken.scope, token items scope. Capability owner-local-only: capabilityUser.ownerLocal, ownToken.issuedVia, token items issuedVia. Capability peer-owner-profile: user.profileSource; host event cutex/users/changed {userId, reason: peerProfile, peerId} when a peer changed a user's displayName / avatar. Home page (capability user-home; own record only, owner or a bound user, pending: 403 access_pending; device scope read may only read): GET /v2/users/me/home → homeView, PUT body homePut → homeView (pins of kind page: capability user-home-page-pins; 409 home_revision_conflict {revision}, 400 invalid_home, 413 home_too_large); GET /v2/users/me/home/cover → the image bytes with an ETag (404 cover_not_found), PUT body homeCoverPut → homeView (400 invalid_cover, 413 cover_too_large), DELETE → homeView.

displayName.description: Set by the user on their own desktop (PATCH /v2/users/me). Clients show displayName ?? name. Absent from hosts without users-self-profile.

avatarEtag.description: ETag of GET /v2/users/{id}/avatar; null = no avatar. Absent from hosts without users-self-profile.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key: base64url without padding of the raw 32 bytes (the JWK x).

fingerprint.description: First 16 hex digits of SHA-256 of the raw 32 key bytes.

tokenPerson.description: The person a device presented (POST /v2/identity/claim). userId = the user holding that key (null = unknown person); previousPublicKey = set when the device later presented another key (its binding never changes by that) until the owner acknowledges it (DELETE /v2/users/token-persons/{tokenId}/previous).

identityChallenge.description:
One use, 30 s. Sign the UTF-8 bytes of "cutex-identity-v1
" + hostId + "
" + nonce + "
" + tokenId. Errors: 429 too_many_challenges.

tokenId.description: The calling client / device token id; "root" for the root credential.

identityClaim.description: Errors: 400 invalid_request / invalid_public_key / challenge_invalid (no live nonce of this credential) / invalid_signature (the nonce is spent either way).

publicKey.description: base64 or base64url of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

signature.description: base64 or base64url of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

nonce.description: The challenge nonce; omitted = every live nonce of the caller is tried (and spent).

displayName.description: Self-set name, shown to the owner on a pending device's card.

outcome.description: autoBound: a pending token was bound to the user holding the key. ownerKeyAdded: the key was added to owner (root credential, or the host's only device bound to owner). pending: unknown person, the device stays pending. recorded: recorded only (a bound token is never rebound).

userId.description: The caller's user after the claim; null = pending.

personUserId.description: The user holding this key, if any.

personKeysPut.description: Replaces the user's keys (empty = none). Errors: 400 invalid_request / invalid_public_key, 404 user_not_found, 409 person_key_in_use (details {publicKey, userId}).

tokenPersonPreviousCleared.description: DELETE /v2/users/token-persons/{tokenId}/previous (owner): the owner acknowledged a device's key change. cleared = a previous key was set (idempotent); the device's current key and binding do not change. 404 client_token_not_found.

name.description: The owner-set label (may be a private alias).

profileSource.description: Capability peer-owner-profile: null = displayName / avatar are direct (PATCH /v2/users/me) or unset; otherwise the listed fields came from a paired peer whose owner holds one of this user's person keys. A direct set or clear always wins over a peer. Absent from hosts without peer-owner-profile.

personKeys.description: The remote owner's keys sent at pairing (person-identity).

selfProfilePatch.description: Omitted = keep, null = clear. Errors: 400 invalid_request / invalid_avatar, 413 avatar_too_large, 403 access_pending.

data.description: Base64 of a square image, 16..=512 px, at most 49152 bytes (desktop sends 128×128).

token.description: The client / device token this request authenticated with (capability user-own-token); null = the root credential. Present for pending devices too.

scope.description: This connection's device scope (capability device-scope); full for the root credential.

ownerLocal.description: Capability owner-local-only: this connection counts as the host itself (a loopback listener with the root credential, or with an owner token issued by `cutex management client-token issue` on the host: the local or an SSH-tunnelled desktop). Root-identity actions need ownerLocal and scope full.

deviceName.description: Reported by the device at pairing.

issuedVia.description: Where the token was issued (capability owner-local-only): hostCli = `cutex management client-token issue` on the host (an SSH-tunnelled desktop), pairing = POST /v2/pair; inferred from kind for tokens of older builds; unknown = never owner-local.

deviceScope.description: Device scope (capability device-scope): full = the user's rights; chat = read + talking to agents; read = read only. Effective rights = the user's rights ∩ the scope.

ownerNewDevices.description: GET /v2/users/owner/new-devices (capability owner-device-notice; owner principals): tokens newly bound to the owner and not acknowledged yet.

items.description: A GET /v2/users tokens[] item plus at, via, current.

at.description: When it was bound to the owner.

ownerDeviceAck.description: POST /v2/users/owner/new-devices/{tokenId}/ack; acknowledged false = there was nothing to acknowledge.

userId.description: The caller's user ("owner" for the root credential and owner-bound tokens).

items.description: A GET /v2/users tokens[] item plus current.

current.description: true = the caller revoked its own token (this device is signed out; later requests with it get 401).

coverEtag.description: ETag of GET /v2/users/me/home/cover; null = no cover. Cover changes do not change revision.

homePin.description: kind page (capability user-home-page-pins): a client page, key <pageId>:<argument>, e.g. project-view:<projectId>; a cutex without the capability answers 400 invalid_home for it.

home.description: Client-owned home page settings, at most 65536 bytes of compact JSON. Unknown keys are kept (forward compatible); unknown keys of blocks / pins items are kept too. Optional keys may be null. coverEtag is server-owned (ignored on PUT).

blocks.description: Shown sections in order; ids unique.

bio.description: At most 200 characters; line breaks allowed, no other control characters.

revision.description: 0 = never written. Grows by one on every change of home.
The revision this edit is based on; another one answers 409 home_revision_conflict {revision: current}.

home.description: null clears the settings (the cover stays).

data.description: Base64 of the image: at most 2097152 bytes, any aspect, each side 1..=4096 px.
